policy_results.detail: Classified multi-step; feature-development graph followed node by node with inspect-before-change and recorded retries.

No secrets in diff. Provider keys are read from env at call time, never stored in config, prompts, logs, or records. No sensitive-path file touched (no *auth*, *secret*, *billing*, *permission*, migrations, workflows, infra). Agent layer has no broker write path; the only broker access is the read-only get_day_trade_count probe, asserted by test.

New (79) and existing (2959) suites pass locally. Default config keeps run_mode=paper, live_trading_enabled=false, agents.enabled=true, agents.llm.enabled=false (asserted by test). No deployment is authorized by this run.
completion_status is 'tested'. Every command listed was executed in this session with the recorded exit code, including the failing first test run.

security_results.detail: Only placeholder names in .env.example comments; no credential values.
tests/agents/test_gate.py::TestContextBuilding::test_gate_never_calls_order_methods_on_broker proves the gate touches only get_day_trade_count.
AgentDecision enforces allow=1.0, block=0.0, 0<reduce<1; main.py applies the multiplier only to an already-approved RiskCheckResult and only when < 1.0.
_assert_live_evidence_gate, validate_safety, DISCLAIMER, and Alpaca credential handling are byte-identical.
No import of trading_bot/crypto or trading_bot/ai/quantum_predictor; no Robinhood, memecoin, Solana, DEX, or wallet references.

unresolved_risks: No independent UIE verification result exists, so this work cannot be promoted from 'tested' to 'verified'.

The OpenAI and Anthropic client wrappers are covered only by an injected fake; a real one-shot call against each provider in a paper session is still outstanding before agents.llm.enabled=true is used.

The veto's min_advisor_confidence (0.55) is applied to the advisor's ADJUSTED confidence, which is lower than the raw signal confidence (e.g. x0.85 with no catalyst). With the gate on this tightens paper entries relative to the pre-gate bot; the operator should review data/agent_decisions.csv after the first paper sessions and tune the threshold deliberately.

Fail-closed gate_error blocks mean a defect inside the agent layer stops all new entries (never lets one through). This is intended, but it is a new way for the bot to go quiet; the agent.gate_error log event should be alerted on.

frontend/package-lock.json carries the same browserslist/fast-uri bump as Dependabot PRs #82 and #83 so the web audit passes; it no-ops once those merge. The web job's lint and build steps were not run locally and are proven by CI only.

rollback.procedure: Runtime: set TRADING_AGENTS__ENABLED=false (gate becomes a no-op allow; behaviour identical to the pre-gate bot). Code: revert the feature commit; no schema or data migration is involved. data/agent_decisions.csv can be deleted freely.
